topic: Dwell time discrepancies in traffic reports
summary_markdown:
A data anomaly was discussed regarding dwell time values appearing in areas where no traffic is recorded. The issue seems related to timezone discrepancies within the reporting system.

[p1] suggested creating a query/task for investigation, noting that the error appears when analyzing client accounts with low traffic volume and that the issue persists even after limiting the time frame.

[me] requested steps to reproduce the bug before proceeding with the task.
decisions: Investigate dwell time discrepancies in reports due to potential timezone issues.
action_items: [p1] will create a query/task for investigation, providing necessary client data and scope details.
